Landlord replied 25 Mar (event 25): "Please go ahead with the removal." I recorded approval 17 as approved (removal/disposal only, ~£600), moved the ticket to provider_selection, emailed the landlord to acknowledge and ask if he wants levelling/gravel quoted, and updated the tenant (removal approved, contractor being arranged, update within 3 working days).

result.summary: The landlord's reply, "Please go ahead with the removal." (event 25), is a clear approval of the removal job Maya described on 15 March at around £600. I recorded the approval, moved the ticket to provider selection, and emailed both the landlord and the tenant. I didn't assign a contractor because the records don't say who it should be: "Oakley's contractor" and Harbour Compliance both appear and may not be the same firm. There's also an open note from Maya to get funds from the landlord up front. I've sent both points to a human and placed a 3-day hold.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 25 is the landlord's answer to the chaser in event 22, which followed Maya's email of 15 March (event 19) describing removal of builders' material at around £600. The classifier rated the intent as approve (1.0) and suggested auto handling. 'Go ahead' approves the attendance described, so the approval is recorded and the job moves forward. Two things stop me assigning a contractor: the provider's name isn't confirmed (event 9 names Harbour Compliance on a £500+VAT quote, but events 15, 16 and 19 refer to Oakley's contractor quoting later), and event 10 asks for the landlord's funds up front. Both are agency decisions that the tenant and landlord can't answer.

alternatives_considered.why_not: It's the only firm named in the records, but the later events point to a different contractor (Oakley's contact) who quoted after 21 February. Assigning the wrong firm could commit the landlord's money to the wrong payee.
The landlord answered clearly, and the system asked whether a reply was needed (event 24). Leaving it would stall a job that has already waited more than two months.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat it as approval for the whole request, including levelling and gravel
alternatives_considered.why_not: The landlord only said 'the removal', so levelling and gravel weren't approved. I asked the landlord whether he wants them quoted.
